turns.learner: Hello! I have an English exam soon. Can we practise polite requests?

planner.explanation: Task-based because B1 or above, partly secure or better, with a real-life goal; main method Formative Assessment & Feedback Loops because: Do the task, then feedback on one or two language errors.

turns.tutor:
Hello! Polite requests are very common in exams and in real life, so this is a good choice.

Our goal today is to ask for something politely, with "Can I have ... please?", instead of a blunt command.

Imagine you are in a café and you are thirsty. The waiter comes to your table. To start, write exactly what you would say to ask for a glass of water. We will look at your sentence together next.
